objective: Verify the admin behaves like a product workflow: presets bridge into Elementor and CPT fields are repeatable, clear, and safely saved.
preconditions: Elementor Implementation Toolkit is available in the local WordPress runtime.
Elementor is active for template bridge verification.
steps: Render Filter Presets and CPT/Post Types admin pages through WP-CLI.
Save a filter preset with multiple filters and verify it remains compatible with FilterController preset resolution.
Create an Elementor filter template for a preset and verify role and preset post meta.
Save a CPT definition with multiple meta fields of different types and verify sanitization keeps compatible option data.
Run a browser smoke that clicks Add filter and Add field controls and checks for no visible overflow.
expected_result: The admin creates useful backend contracts and hands visual editing to Elementor without fixed-row field limits or first-glance provider noise.
pass_criteria: Filter template manager creates plugin-owned elementor_library templates with preset metadata.
CPT form supports dynamically adding more than one meta field.
Preset form supports dynamically adding filter rows.
Nonce and capability checks remain on state-changing admin actions.
PHP lint and JS syntax checks pass.
